scope: Distal blade / skinned body, blade / blade, and blade / flat floor. Surface crossing test with the intentional proximal socket overlap excluded. No continuous collision guarantee or scene-obstacle / blend validation. Existing body-to-body gait intersections are unchanged.

clips.label: Running
clips.description: Running holds the upper arms about 14° farther out and adjusts the elbows by at most 7°. The stride, body lean, loop seam and blade dimensions are preserved.

clips.label: Recoil
clips.description: A smooth correction to the right upper arm and elbow around the backward step. The original backward travel is preserved.

clips.label: Reprimand
clips.description: A brief right-arm correction around the gesture that previously intersected the shin. The rest of the gesture is unchanged.

clips.label: Rise from kneeling
clips.description: Both arms keep their blades outside the knees. Elbow orientation also keeps the blades above a flat floor. The source clip starts kneeling and rises; it is not a full kneel-and-rise cycle.

clips.label: Electrical collapse
clips.description: The forearms rotate to avoid driving the blades through the floor. The right-arm lift leads the impact and is smoothed across neighboring frames. This is the most substantial choreography change and needs particular artistic review.
